[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: B3_BOTH_AMBIGUOUS
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: A position was filled, its stop was still not confirmed by the exchange after the allowed time and the entry order is still open (B3_BOTH_AMBIGUOUS).
Position: A position may be open without a confirmed stop, and the open entry may still fill and add to it.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert. Before this, the stop and the entry were queried by id on every step and the cancel of the entry was issued again on each step.
You must: Check the exchange position, the open entry order and the journal before any manual action. Cancel the entry if it is still open, and close or protect any open position yourself.
